{{Top|leg}}
A '''battle skiff''' was a combat vehicle employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Battle skiffs were part of the complement of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Victory-class)|''Dominator'']], and were deployed during the [[Battle of Taul|First Battle of Taul]].
